STORIES.headline: Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade postponed to Saturday due to expected bad weather
STORIES.summary: NBC announced the parade will take place on Saturday, citing safety concerns for participants and spectators after discussions with city officials.
article: NBC announced the parade will take place on Saturday, citing safety concerns for participants and spectators after discussions with city officials. New York, Macy’s, and NBC have jointly decided to move the parade to Saturday due to extreme weather, prioritizing safety for all attendees. NBC will air a rerun of the 2025 Macy’s Thanksgiving Day Parade on Thursday instead of the original date.

Macy’s has postponed its Thanksgiving Day Parade to Saturday as powerful winds are forecast for New York, NBC reported Wednesday. NBC confirmed the parade will be held on Saturday, citing safety concerns and discussions with city leaders. A joint statement from the city, Macy’s, and NBC confirms the parade will be moved to Saturday due to severe weather and safety concerns.
STORIES.imageAlt: A huge balloon depicting Minnie Mouse floats above a crowd of people in a parade, surrounded by skyscrapers in the New York cityscape.

STORIES.headline: Kilmar Abrego Garcia self-deports to Spain after years of legal battles
STORIES.summary: Kilmar Abrego Garcia, known as the 'Maryland man,' voluntarily left the U.S. for Spain after a long legal struggle with the Trump administration.
article: Kilmar Abrego Garcia, known as the 'Maryland man,' voluntarily left the U.S. for Spain after a long legal struggle with the Trump administration. The flight departed late Tuesday, delayed multiple times due to mechanical issues, and was rerouted three times before taking off.

Kilmar Abrego Garcia, the 'Maryland dad' championed by Democrats, has left the U.S. for Spain under a government agreement after nearly two years of legal conflict. Democrats have hailed the self-deportation as a win, despite earlier claims of defending him from deportation.
STORIES.imageAlt: Kilmar Abrego Garcia self-deports to Spain after years of legal battles

STORIES.headline: At least 30 killed in blaze after vehicle overturns in Egypt, health ministry says
STORIES.summary: Road accidents are common in Egypt due to speeding, weak traffic enforcement, and poor road conditions.
article: Road accidents are common in Egypt due to speeding, weak traffic enforcement, and poor road conditions.

A fire broke out on a major highway around Cairo on Wednesday, killing at least 30 people, Egypt’s Health Ministry said. The cause of the fire was not immediately clear, though the ministry confirmed at least 15 others were injured. Rescue workers were extracting people from burning vehicles on the Ring Road, a key route encircling Cairo. AP footage shows firefighters battling flames spreading among cars, with hundreds gathering near the Warraq district of Imbaba.
STORIES.imageAlt: People stand next to the wreck of a car in the aftermath of a fire that broke out on a highway in the Al-Waraq neighbourhood of Imbaba district, Giza Governorate, Cairo.

STORIES.headline: China’s Huawei convicted of stealing US trade secrets
STORIES.summary: A US federal jury convicted Huawei on 10 of 12 criminal counts, including trade secret theft and bank fraud, amid allegations of deception about its Iran operations.
article: A US federal jury convicted Huawei on 10 of 12 criminal counts, including trade secret theft and bank fraud, amid allegations of deception about its Iran operations. Huawei and its subsidiaries were found guilty by a Brooklyn jury on 10 of 12 counts, including conspiracy to steal trade secrets and defraud US banks. Huawei was acquitted of racketeering conspiracy, which accused it of operating as a criminal enterprise.
A federal jury convicted Huawei and its subsidiaries of violating US sanctions on Iran, stealing trade secrets, and engaging in money laundering.
STORIES.imageAlt: China’s Huawei convicted of stealing US trade secrets

STORIES.headline: What are king tides? These exceptionally high tides are increasingly flooding coastal communities
STORIES.summary: The term 'king tide' is a colloquial term for exceptionally high tides, not a scientific designation.
article: The term 'king tide' is a colloquial term for exceptionally high tides, not a scientific designation. The 2026 super El Niño has raised coastal water levels, intensifying the impact of king tides.

The Bay Area is preparing for a storm system arriving on Tuesday and lasting through Wednesday with wet and windy conditions. The National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration defines 'king tide' as a non-scientific term for exceptionally high tides. King tides typically occur from November to January, when the sun and moon align during the tidal swing, peaking around December.
STORIES.imageAlt: What are king tides? These exceptionally high tides are increasingly flooding coastal communities

STORIES.headline: Unclassified CIA system breached in cyberattack
STORIES.summary: A CIA system used to review publicly available information suffered a security breach, a source familiar with the matter confirmed.
article: A CIA system used to review publicly available information suffered a security breach, a source familiar with the matter confirmed. The breach affected a system that processes data from online searches, public records, and purchased data broker sources.

The CIA and the Office of the Director of National Intelligence detected a cyber intrusion that exposed unclassified data from an open-source intelligence analysis system, according to The New York Times on Tuesday. This breach differs from recent technical outages and is confirmed to be a security incident.
STORIES.imageAlt: Unclassified CIA system breached in cyberattack

STORIES.headline: Israeli judges recommend dropping one bribery case against Netanyahu
STORIES.summary: Israeli judges recommended prosecutors drop one of three cases against Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, urging reconsideration of another bribery allegation.
article: Israeli judges recommended prosecutors drop one of three cases against Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, urging reconsideration of another bribery allegation. Netanyahu was indicted in 2019 on bribery, fraud, and breach of trust, maintaining his not guilty plea in all charges. Prosecutors claim Netanyahu sought favorable coverage for himself and wife Sara on a news site run by former Bezeq chairman Shaul Elovitch.

Judges have recommended dropping one of the corruption cases against Netanyahu, offering a significant defense advantage in the ongoing trial. The move, seen as a major boost for Netanyahu amid political pressure, was welcomed by his right-wing supporters who called for the trial to conclude.
STORIES.imageAlt: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu delivers a media statement at the Knesset, the Israeli parliament, in Jerusalem wearing a dark suit and dark tie.

STORIES.headline: China sends first foreign astronaut to ISS rival as it globalises space operations
STORIES.summary: Muhammad Zeeshan Ali, Pakistan’s first astronaut, arrived at China’s Tiangong space station in a space handshake marking a milestone in global space collaboration.
article: Muhammad Zeeshan Ali, Pakistan’s first astronaut, arrived at China’s Tiangong space station in a space handshake marking a milestone in global space collaboration. Muhammad Zeeshan Ali entered Tiangong space station via a hatch, greeted by crew members in what China described as its first foreign 'space handshake'.

Pakistan marked a historic milestone as Zeeshan Ali became the first of its citizens to reach China’s Tiangong space station, advancing international cooperation in space science. The Shenzhou-24 spacecraft completed a successful orbital insertion, with the CMSA confirming the launch as a full success and noting the vehicle’s planned automated docking with Tiangong within hours.
STORIES.imageAlt: China sends first foreign astronaut to ISS rival as it globalises space operations

STORIES.headline: EasyJet boss unable to rule out further job losses after profits collapse by 96%
STORIES.summary: EasyJet's CEO Kenton Jarvis says further job losses are possible and some rival airlines could go bust amid rising fuel costs from the Iran war.
article: EasyJet's CEO Kenton Jarvis says further job losses are possible and some rival airlines could go bust amid rising fuel costs from the Iran war. EasyJet's pre-tax profit fell 96% to £24m in the year ending September, down from £658m the prior year.

EasyJet plans to retire more than 50 ageing Airbus A319s over two years to replace them with more fuel-efficient models. EasyJet’s pre-tax profit dropped nearly 90% to £71m in the year ending September as high oil prices hurt profits. Despite the downturn, EasyJet’s total revenue rose 6% to £3.8bn, with CEO Kenton Jarvis citing the Middle East conflict as a key factor in the financial strain.
STORIES.imageAlt: EasyJet boss unable to rule out further job losses after profits collapse by 96%

STORIES.headline: UK will not offer equal tuition fees for EU students, says Burnham
STORIES.summary: Burnham stated that equal fees for UK and EU students won’t be considered in upcoming negotiations, rejecting a proposal pushed by Kemi Badenoch.
article: Burnham stated that equal fees for UK and EU students won’t be considered in upcoming negotiations, rejecting a proposal pushed by Kemi Badenoch. Burnham clarified that the UK is not adopting the EU’s negotiating stance on tuition fees, saying the idea has not been raised in British discussions.

Andy Burnham has indicated that EU students will pay higher tuition fees than UK students, as the fee agreement remains under discussion. The tuition fee issue, which was highlighted in Burnham’s Brussels statement, remains unresolved and is being given an extra six months to finalize.

STORIES.headline: Pentagon reportedly in talks with GM, Ford to scale US military drone production
STORIES.summary: Defense officials are exploring partnerships with automakers and parts suppliers like Magna International to supply drone components such as motors and sensors, according to people familiar with the matter.
article: Defense officials are exploring partnerships with automakers and parts suppliers like Magna International to supply drone components such as motors and sensors, according to people familiar with the matter. No deals have been finalized, and industry executives have raised concerns about profit margins and the viability of entering the weapons supply chain.

These preliminary talks are part of a broader strategy to use the automotive sector’s manufacturing expertise to meet defense supply demands. GM is considering producing drone motors, while other manufacturers may supply parts to existing drone companies, as reported by The Wall Street Journal.
STORIES.imageAlt: Pentagon reportedly in talks with GM, Ford to scale US military drone production

STORIES.headline: Astronomers discover the most distant and ancient quasar powered by a supermassive black hole
STORIES.summary: The Euclid space telescope has detected a quasar powered by a supermassive black hole 360 million times more massive than the Sun.
article: The Euclid space telescope has detected a quasar powered by a supermassive black hole 360 million times more massive than the Sun. The black hole is observed as it existed just 630 million years after the Big Bang. Its existence deepens the mystery of how supermassive black holes reached such massive sizes so early in the universe's history.

Astronomers led by Julien Wolf at the Max Planck Institute for Astronomy discovered the most distant quasar ever recorded. The object was first spotted in the Euclid Wide Survey and confirmed through ground and space-based observations.
STORIES.imageAlt: Astronomers discover oldest known quasar forming 630 million years after the Big Bang
